name: BITS Limited
about: BITS Limited provides educational services in India and internationally. It offers education services in the field of art, commerce, science, computer software, computer hardware, business management, hotel management, engineering and technical education, and other fields through institutes, colleges, and universities. The company also provides corporate management training through classroom training and other modes. In addition, it engages in the trade, import, and export of software solutions, as well as the purchase, sale, lease, letting, hiring, sub-leasing, and subletting of properties. The company was formerly known as Bits India Ltd. and changed its name to BITS Limited in October 2000. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Mumbai, India. BITS Limited operates as a subsidiary of Vizwise Commerce Pvt. Ltd.
